sources.title: Naga City Ordinance No. 2003-003, Section 6
sources.note: Enacted January 15, 2003. Lists the home at the corner of Barlin and Dimasalang streets, unnamed, separately from the Badiola home.

sources.title: Google Street View
sources.note: August 2025 panorama inspected October 8, 2026. Of the four corners, only two hold old houses: this green wooden two-storey house on the north corner and the Badiola house (Jikka) on the east corner. The south corner is a walled lot and the west corner a modern shop row. With the east-corner house identified as the Badiola home, the listed corner home is identified by elimination. Capture dates are not construction dates. No image is saved or distributed.
